title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 7: A1+ ADVENTURE & COMMUNICATION
description: A richer beginner-to-elementary communication world focused on connected speech, longer comprehension, practical grammar, everyday problem solving, and independent English production.

missions.title: Question Master 2.0
missions.focus: wh- questions, yes/no questions, short answers, asking for details

missions.title: People, Personality & Feelings
missions.focus: describing people, personality adjectives, feelings, reasons

missions.title: Daily Routines in Detail
missions.focus: present simple, frequency adverbs, time expressions, connected sentences

missions.title: Yesterday and Last Weekend
missions.focus: past simple of common regular and irregular verbs

missions.title: Comparing My World
missions.focus: comparatives, superlatives, bigger/smaller/better/worse, giving reasons

missions.title: Food, Quantities & Shopping
missions.focus: countable/uncountable nouns, some/any, much/many, prices and quantities

missions.title: Plans for Tomorrow
missions.focus: be going to, future plans, intentions, invitations

missions.title: Can I Have...?
missions.focus: polite requests, permission, offers, can/could, classroom and everyday language

missions.title: Around Town
missions.focus: places, directions, prepositions, asking for and giving directions

missions.title: Conversation Lab — Five Minutes
missions.focus: sustained A1+ conversation using questions, follow-ups, opinions and reasons

missions.title: Reading Detective — The Missing Backpack
missions.focus: 350–450 word story, sequencing events, identifying details and simple inference

missions.title: Listening Detective — A Busy Saturday
missions.focus: natural A1+ listening, key details, times, places, plans and corrections

missions.title: Build a Real Paragraph
missions.focus: topic sentence, supporting details, sequence words, because/and/but/so

missions.title: Story Builder — Then, Now, Next
missions.focus: past events, present situation and future plans in one connected story

missions.title: Travel Mission — Station to Hotel
missions.focus: tickets, platforms, schedules, check-in, directions and simple travel problems

missions.title: Problem Solver — Something Went Wrong
missions.focus: explaining a simple problem, asking for help, suggesting solutions and responding politely

missions.title: Opinion Power
missions.focus: I think..., I like..., I prefer..., because..., agreeing and disagreeing politely

missions.title: English-Only Challenge
missions.focus: communicating meaning without translation through description, paraphrase, gestures and examples

missions.title: A1+ Communication Marathon
missions.focus: integrated vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing under time pressure

missions.title: WORLD 7 FINAL MASTER QUEST — A1+ TO A2
missions.focus: multi-skill final mission with real-life dialogue, reading comprehension, listening, paragraph writing, speaking and mastery review

content_targets.reading: 350–450 word texts with detail questions and simple inference
content_targets.listening: 3–5 minute A1+ recordings with natural pauses and everyday speed
content_targets.mastery: Learner can connect ideas, ask follow-up questions, describe past events, discuss plans, solve simple everyday communication problems, and produce connected beginner English with reduced translation support.
